text.en:
Transition Mechanism.
Until such time that the
Secretariat for the peace process is fully organized and
operational, the NUC Secretariat created under Executive Order No.
19 (s. 1992) shall continue to provide staff support to the PAPP in
the implementation of the comprehensive peace process.
under the direct control and supervision of the PAPP.
Secretariat is authorized to continue receiving, disbursing and
accounting for funds released for the peace process.
funds as defined under Section
6 of this Executive Order are
released for the peace process, the NUC Secretariat shall advance
funding support from its own budget for the operations of the PAPP
and the GPNPS.
All assets, funds, records, equipment, facilities,
properties, choses in action, as well as the personnel of the NUC
Secretariat are hereby transferred to the Secretariat of the PAPP.
Repealing Clause.
All executive orders, rules
and regulations and other issuances or parts thereof, which are

inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.
effect immediately.
Effectivity.
This Executive Order shall take
DONE in the city of Manila, this
year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Thre
day of September in the
